g.text: WEMOS LOLIN32 v1 • TB6612FNG Dual Driver • 3× VL53L0X ToF Sensors
• VM (High Voltage): Connects ONLY to 2S LiPo (+) [7.4V–11.1V] for motor power.
• VCC (Logic Supply): Connected to LOLIN32 3.3V rail. NEVER hook LiPo to VCC!
• Common Ground: LOLIN32 GND and Battery (–) MUST be connected together.
(Without a common ground, motor PWM and ToF I2C signals will float unpredictably).
• STBY Pin: Pulled HIGH to 3.3V (GPIO 4) to enable motor driver outputs.
• All VL53L0X ToF sensors start at default factory I2C address 0x29.
• At startup, the firmware asserts all XSHUT pins LOW into hardware shutdown.
• Each sensor is enabled one-by-one and reassigned a unique runtime I2C address:
Left (0x30): GPIO 18 | Center (0x31): GPIO 19 | Right (0x32): GPIO 23
• Shared Hardware I2C Bus: SDA on GPIO 21 and SCL on GPIO 22.
